summary: Chanson International Holding (Nasdaq: CHSN), a Cayman-incorporated, Urumqi-based food products issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026 containing a notice and proxy for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 26, 2026 in hybrid format. Shareholders will vote on an ordinary resolution increasing authorized share capital to US$412.5 billion, then a special resolution reducing par value from US$0.01 to US$0.000000001 per share. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or closing terms are stated. The structural change increases authorized share count for future issuances. Watch for dilution and Nasdaq bid-price compliance implications.
